Hi Samir — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and next steps: 

- Key needs you called out: lower per-token inference cost for customer-facing flows, tighter latency SLOs for peak hours, and a path for on-prem/private deployment for sensitive workflows.
- Primary success criteria: sub-200ms p95 for short chat flows, predictable per-request pricing, and SOC2+audit logs for sensitive datasets.

As discussed, the best next step is a short 30-minute demo/technical deep-dive so we can: 1) show a targeted walkthrough of the runtime for your use case, 2) align on integration points, and 3) confirm an initial mutual action plan.

Can you share 2–3 people from your side who should join (we recommend a product/PO, an engineering lead, and procurement/security if available)? Here are a few 30-min slots from our side next week (PT):

- Tue 2026-03-17 09:00–09:30 PT
- Tue 2026-03-17 13:00–13:30 PT
- Wed 2026-03-18 11:00–11:30 PT

If none of those work, propose a couple windows and we’ll do our best to accommodate. I attached the post-discovery notes and a short product one-pager for context. I’ll follow up with a calendar invite once we lock a time.

Thanks — looking forward to continuing the conversation.
